# Helvety Auth

> Shared Helvety Auth for OTP and passkey flows that gate the encrypted productivity apps. Open source, operated from Switzerland.

## Canonical URL
- [Sign In](https://helvety.com/auth/login): Primary sign-in page

## Crawling And Indexing
- Auth routes are intended not to be indexed.
- These routes are not intended as crawl targets and use noindex metadata. The sign-in route is publicly reachable by design, while session-based checks apply where required.
